import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import warnings
import os
import time
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)
start_time = time.time()

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Map authors to labels
label_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_labels = train_df["author"].map(label_map).values
label_names = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Split training data into train/validation (hold-out for validation only)
X_train_texts, X_val_texts, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["text"].values,
    train_labels,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_labels,
)

# Combine word-level and character-level TF-IDF features
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), analyzer="word", max_features=20000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(3, 3), analyzer="char", max_features=15000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

# Fit on training split only (prevents leakage)
X_train_word = tfidf_word.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_train_char = tfidf_char.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_val_word = tfidf_word.transform(X_val_texts)
X_val_char = tfidf_char.transform(X_val_texts)
X_test_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_df["text"])

print(f"Word features: {X_train_word.shape[1]}")
print(f"Character features: {X_train_char.shape[1]}")

# Stack word and character features
X_train = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

print(f"Combined features: {X_train.shape[1]}")

# Train base Logistic Regression with L2 regularization
base_lr = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42, multi_class="multinomial"
)
base_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Train Random Forest with optimized hyperparameters
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=5,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    max_features="sqrt",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=False,
)
rf_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
print(f"Random Forest trained in {time.time() - start_time:.1f}s")

# Train LightGBM as the third model family (new improvement)
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=8,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=128,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)
lgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
print(f"LightGBM trained in {time.time() - start_time:.1f}s")

# Get base probability predictions from all three models on validation set
lr_y_val_pred = base_lr.predict_proba(X_val)
rf_y_val_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)
lgb_y_val_pred = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Average probabilities from all three models (new weighted ensemble)
ensemble_y_val_pred = (lr_y_val_pred + rf_y_val_pred + lgb_y_val_pred) / 3

# Ensure probabilities sum to 1
ensemble_y_val_pred = ensemble_y_val_pred / ensemble_y_val_pred.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)

# Calibrate using Platt scaling with base LR as the primary calibrated model
# This improves probability calibration for log loss
calibrated_lr = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42, multi_class="multinomial"
    ),
    method="sigmoid",
    cv=5,
)
calibrated_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Get calibrated probability predictions on validation set
calibrated_y_val_pred = calibrated_lr.predict_proba(X_val)

# Ensure probabilities sum to 1
calibrated_y_val_pred = calibrated_y_val_pred / calibrated_y_val_pred.sum(
    axis=1, keepdims=True
)

# Evaluate calibrated model on validation set
val_log_loss_calibrated = log_loss(y_val, calibrated_y_val_pred, labels=[0, 1, 2])
print(f"Validation Log Loss (calibrated): {val_log_loss_calibrated:.6f}")

# Get ensemble predictions on test set with calibration
lr_test_pred = base_lr.predict_proba(X_test)
rf_test_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test)
lgb_test_pred = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_test)
ensemble_test_pred = (lr_test_pred + rf_test_pred + lgb_test_pred) / 3

# Apply calibrated classifier to test set
calibrated_test_pred = calibrated_lr.predict_proba(X_test)

# Use calibrated predictions for submission (improved probability quality)
# Final ensemble combines calibration with base ensemble for best results
final_test_pred = 0.5 * calibrated_test_pred + 0.5 * ensemble_test_pred

# Ensure probabilities sum to 1 (required format)
final_test_pred = final_test_pred / final_test_pred.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": final_test_pred[:, 0],
        "HPL": final_test_pred[:, 1],
        "MWS": final_test_pred[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save to submission directory
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved with {len(submission)} rows at ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Total time: {time.time() - start_time:.1f}s")
